y-m-43-02.title: Kutarisa kufunga kwaYerin 'sezvinoita nhamba'
y-m-43-02.topic: Ma matrices maviri ane product i zero matrix (AB=O)
y-m-43-02.goal: Edza kana property inoshanda kunhamba ichigona kutamiswa kuma matrices sezvayakaita, gadzira muenzaniso apo AB=O asi hapana A kana B i zero matrix uye utsanangure kuti sei uchishandisa property ye A, uye usarudze mamiriro apo mhedziso inoshanda.
y-m-43-02.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nemutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) i mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] i matrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E i identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O i zero matrix ine ma entries ese 0. Kunhamba, kana ab=0 saka a=0 kana b=0. Yerin akati, 'Ma matrices anewo mitemo yekuwedzera nekuwanza, saka kana AB=O saka A=O kana B=O.' Mubasa iri A=[1 2 ; 2 4] yakasimbiswa, uye A haisi zero matrix.
y-m-43-02.thinking.0: Wana mutsetse apo mhedziso yakagadzirwa nekufananidza ('sezvinoita nhamba')
y-m-43-02.thinking.1: Gadzira muenzaniso apo hazvishande uye utsanangure kuti sei
y-m-43-02.prereq.2: Chokwadi chekuti kunhamba, kana ab=0 saka a=0 kana b=0 (padanho remiddle school)
y-m-43-02.prereq.3: Ruzivo rwekare rwekuti kuva ne inverse matrix kunoreva kuti pane matrix inopa E kana yawanzwa
y-m-43-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe munyaya yaYerin usina hwaro.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ronga mutsetse mumwe nemumwe kuita chirevo nezvenhamba, chirevo nezvema matrices, kana mhedziso.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wana mutsetse unogona kuva hwaro hwemutsetse 3, uye uenzanise kana uchitaura chimwe chinhu munzira imwechete nemutsetse 3.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.0: Kunhamba, kana ab=0 saka a=0 kana b=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.1: Ma matrices anewo mitemo yekuwedzera nekuwanza, sezvinoita nhamba.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.2: Naizvozvo kuma matrices zvakare, kana AB=O saka A=O kana B=O.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.line.3: Chaizvo, kana A=O saka AB=O chero B i chii.
y-m-43-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 i kubhururuka. Mutsetse 1 i chokwadi chakarurama nezvenhamba, uye mutsetse 2 unoti chete kuti ma matrices anewo mitemo, kwete kuti i 'mitemo yakafanana nenhamba'. Mutsetse 4 wakarurawo, asi unotaura nzira imwe chete, 'kana A=O saka AB=O'. Chinodiwa nemutsetse 3 i nzira yakapesana (kana AB=O saka A=O kana B=O), saka mutsetse 4 hautsigire mutsetse 3. Kana property inoshanda kunhamba ichishandawo kuma matrices inofanira kuedzwa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.prompt: Kune A=[1 2 ; 2 4], gadzira B=[p q ; r s] mbiri dzakasiyana ne AB=O apo B isiri zero matrix. Ipapo tsanangura pazasi kuti sei B yakadaro ichivapo.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma entries mana e AB nema p, q, r, s, uaise rimwe nerimwe pa 0, uye uverenge kuti ma equations akasiyana mangani anobuda.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa zvakaparadzana ma equations e column yekutanga (p, r) uye e column yechipiri (q, s), uye usarudze mitengo inogutsa imwe neimwe.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Mutsetse wekutanga we AB wese i 0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Mutsetse wekutanga we AB une entry isiri 0. Nyora ma entries emutsetse wekutanga nema p, q, r, s.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Mutsetse wechipiri we AB wese i 0 zvakare. Saka AB=O.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Mutsetse wechipiri we AB une entry isiri 0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.fail.c3: B i zero matrix. Unofanira kuwana B isiri zero matrix.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana B=[-2 0 ; 1 0], saka AB=[0 0 ; 0 0]. Hapana A kana B i zero matrix asi product i zero matrix, saka mutsetse 3 waYerin hauna kururama. Kupa muenzaniso mumwe kwakakwana kuputsa 'nguva dzose'. Panguva ino, ma B ari multiples emumwe nemumwe (semuenzaniso [-2 0 ; 1 0] ne [-4 0 ; 2 0]) anoverengwawo semienzaniso yakasiyana.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Pa B yawangogadzira, nyora mumashoko 1 kana 2 kuti sei AB inova zero matrix, uchitaura property imwe ye A.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Neya B yawakagadzira pamusoro, nyora mutengo waunowana nekuwanza mutsetse wekutanga we A nechokutanga column ye B uye kuwedzera.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isa mitsetse miviri ye A (1, 2 ne 2, 4) padivi pedivi uye utange wanyora mushoko rimwe kuti ine hukama hupi.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Chikonzero chawakanyora chinosvika pa property ye A (kuti determinant yayo i 0, kuti mitsetse yayo i proportional, nezvimwewo), kana wakangodzokorora 'nekuti AB i O' here?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakawanza chaizvo imwe B yawakagadzira ne A uye wakatarisa nenhamba kuti inova zero matrix here?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga kana B imwechete ichiramba ichishanda kana A yachinja (semuenzaniso A=[1 0 ; 0 1]) here?
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Determinant ye A i 1×4-2×2=0, saka hapana inverse matrix. Saka kana ukatora column imwe ye B sa (-2, 1), product ne A inopa 0, uye AB=O inogona kuitika kunyange kana B isiri zero matrix.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mutsetse wechipiri we A i ka2 yemutsetse wekutanga, saka kana ukaita mutsetse mumwe chete 0, mutsetse wechipiri unova 0 pachawo. Kana ukatora column ye B se (2, -1), saka 1×2+2×(-1)=0.
y-m-43-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Imwe mhinduro yemuenzaniso, inotsanangurwa nehukama hwe proportional hwemitsetse.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana A isiri zero matrix, mamiriro api anokubvumira kupedzisa 'kana AB=O saka B=O'?
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.0: Yeuka A iyi ne B yawakagadzira mudanho rakapfuura, uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kana mamiriro ega ega anoshanda kuna A iyoyo.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga watsanangura mumashoko kuti sei, kunhamba, ab=0 ne a≠0 zvinokubvumira kutaura b=0, uchishandisa 'patsanura ne a', wobva wafunga kuti chii chinoita basa rekupatsanura mu matrices.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.a: Ma entries ese e A i nhamba dzisiri 0
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.a: A=[1 2 ; 2 4] iyi inewo ma entries ese asiri 0, asi pakanga paine muenzaniso apo B isiri zero matrix. Uchibatanidza nemuenzaniso wedanho rakapfuura, mamiriro aya haakwani.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.b: A^2, square ye A, haisi zero matrix zvakare
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.b: A^2=[5 10 ; 10 20] haisi zero matrix zvakare, asi pakanga paine muenzaniso ne B≠O. Mamiriro akafanana kana ukatora ma powers e A.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.c: Pane matrix inopa E kana yawanzwa ne A
y-m-43-02.s.s3.o.d: A i square matrix (2×2) uye haisi zero matrix
y-m-43-02.s.s3.r.d: A iyi yaiva 2×2 zvakare uye counterexample yakaonekwa. Hukuru hwe matrix hahuvimbise mhedziso iyi.
y-m-43-02.s.s3.explain: Kana A ine inverse matrix A^(-1), kuwanza A^(-1) kuruboshwe kwemativi ese e AB=O kunopa B=O. Izvi zvakafanana nemamiriro ekuti determinant haisi 0. Zvakapesana, kana determinant i 0, muenzaniso ne B≠O unogona kuuya, sezvawaita panguva ino.

y-m-43-04.title: Kugona kuverengwa nekuva nezvinoreva
y-m-43-04.topic: Zvinoreva matrix product: mitsetse nema columns etebhura rehuwandu netebhura remitengo
y-m-43-04.goal: Siyanisa zvinogona kuverengwa kana matebhura maviri akawanzwa nezvinoita kuti mhedzisiro ive neine zvinoreva, dudzira zvinoreva ma entries emhedzisiro, uye utsanangure kuti entry imwe yekuverenga nekurongeka kwakashandurwa inoverenga chii.
y-m-43-04.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nemutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) i mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] i matrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E i identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O i zero matrix ine ma entries ese 0. Pachikoro, Kirasi 1 neKirasi 2 vanotenga chingwa nemukaka sezvikwereti. Tebhura rehuwandu N rine mitsetse yemakirasi (mutsetse wekutanga Kirasi 1, wechipiri Kirasi 2) uye ma columns ezvinhu (column yekutanga chingwa, yechipiri mukaka): N=[3 2 ; 1 4]. (Kirasi 1 inotenga machingwa 3 nemukaka 2, Kirasi 2 inotenga chingwa 1 nemukaka 4.) Tebhura remitengo P rine mitsetse yezvinhu (mutsetse wekutanga chingwa, wechipiri mukaka) uye ma columns ezvitoro (column yekutanga chitoro X, yechipiri chitoro Y): P=[1500 1800 ; 1000 1200]. (Yuniti i 원. Pachitoro X, chingwa i 1500원 uye mukaka i 1000원 / pachitoro Y, chingwa i 1800원 uye mukaka i 1200원.) Vanoda kuziva mari yose yakashandiswa nekirasi imwe neimwe nechitoro chimwe nechimwe. Jiho akati, 'Wanza N ne P nenhevedzano iyi chete,' uye Seoa akati, 'Zvose i 2×2, saka kuwanza P ne N kunogonawo kuverengwa, saka kurongeka hakukosha.'

y-m-43-05.title: Kuunganidza ma matrices anova identity matrix kana akaitwa square
y-m-43-05.topic: Ma matrices anogutsa A^2=E nezvinhu zvavo zvakafanana
y-m-43-05.goal: Simbisa nekugadzira mienzaniso kuti mhinduro dze x^2=1 kunhamba, mbiri chete, dzakawanda zvikuru kuma matrices, wana zvinhu zvakafanana pakati pemienzaniso yawakagadzira uye uzvironge, uye utsanangure nekuverenga kuti sei izvi zvichisiyana nenhamba.
y-m-43-05.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nemutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) i mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] i matrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E i identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O i zero matrix ine ma entries ese 0. Kunhamba x, kana x^2=1 saka x=1 kana x=-1. Kune 2×2 matrix A=[a b ; c d], wana A inogutsa A^2=E. Ma entries haafaniri kuva ma integers, asi kana ukafungidzira mutengo we square-root nedecimal, mhinduro yakarurama inogona kubuda seisiri iyo, saka zviri nani kushandisa ma integers kana nhamba dzinobuda chaizvo, sa 0.6 ne 0.8. (A^2 i matrix A yakawanzwa kaviri, kwete entry imwe neimwe yakaitwa square.)

y-m-43-05.s.s2.prompt: Funga uchirangarira mienzaniso yakasiyana neyawakangogadzira. Sarudza zvose zvinofanira kushanda kuma matrix A=[a b ; c d] ose ane A^2=E umo A isiri E kana -E.

y-m-43-05.s.s2.r.c: Kuna [1 2 ; 0 -1], b=2 uye c=0. Unogona kunge wakaparadzanisa wakatarisa chete mienzaniso ine chimiro chakaenzana ([0 1 ; 1 0]).

y-m-43-05.s.s2.explain: Kana A^2=E uye A isiri E kana -E, saka a+d=0 ne ad-bc=-1. Chikonzero ndechokuti A^2=E inopa b(a+d)=0 ne c(a+d)=0; kana b=c=0, saka a ne d ndi ±1 uye (a, d)=(1, -1) kana (-1, 1) inodikanwa kuti A isave E kana -E, saka a+d=0, uye kana b kana c isiri 0, saka a+d=0. Wobva kubva pa a^2+bc=1, ad-bc=-a^2-bc=-1. Zvinhu hazvifaniri kuva nhamba dzizere, hazvifaniri kuva 0 dzose, uye b=c haidikanwi.
y-m-43-05.s.s3.prompt: Kunhamba x, mhinduro dze x^2=1 ndi 1 ne -1 chete, asi kuma matrix pane dzakawanda zvakawanda. Sarudza imwe A yawakagadzira pamusoro, verenga zvinhu zve A^2 zvakananga kuti uzviratidze, uye unyore mumitsara 1 kana 2 kuti sei izvi zvakasiyana nenhamba.

y-m-43-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here sikweya ye A yawakasarudza chinhu nechinhu uye wakaratidza kuti E inobuda?

y-m-43-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kuti sei chikonzero chokuti x^2=1 kunhamba ine mhinduro mbiri chete (kuparadzira zvinhu nezvimwewo) chisingashandiswi nenzira imwe chete kumatrix?
y-m-43-05.s.s3.model.0: Kana A=[0 1 ; 1 0], chinhu chekutanga che A^2 ndi 0×0+1×1=1 uye zvimwe zvinhu zvi 0×1+1×0=0. Mazwi anova 0 anomuka mumuwandu wezvakawanikwa, uye inova E. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti, zvakasiyana nesikweya yenhamba, zvinhu zvakati wandei zvinosanganiswa uye zvinowedzerwa.
y-m-43-05.s.s3.model.1: Mu [3 2 ; -4 -3]^2, chinhu (1, 1) ndi 3×3+2×(-4)=1 uye chinhu (1, 2) ndi 3×2+2×(-3)=0. Mazwi ari pamusoro nenegative anobvisana uye inova E, uye mu x^2 yenhamba hakuna kubvisana kwakadaro.
y-m-43-05.s.s3.model.2: Kana A=[0 1 ; 1 0], saka A^2=E uye (A-E)(A+E)=A^2-E=O. Asi nga A-E=[-1 1 ; 1 -1] nga A+E=[1 1 ; 1 1] hakuna iri zero matrix. Chakawanikwa chema matrix maviri asiri zero matrix chinogona kuva O, saka zvakasiyana nenhamba, haugoni kuti "imwe yeviri ndi 0."
y-m-43-05.s.s3.modelNote.2: Mhinduro inopa zero divisors (ma matrix maviri asiri zero ane chakawanikwa O) sechikonzero.

y-m-43-06.goal: Ongorora kuparadzanisa kunotora peya yakangoshanda sehumbowo hwokuti inoshanda, gadzira ma matrix umo fomula inoputsika uye utarise kuti inoputsika pasi pemamiriro api, uye unyore kupokana kwakavakirwa pamhedzisiro iyoyo.
y-m-43-06.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nomutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) ndiwo mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] imatrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nomutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E ndiyo identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O ndiyo zero matrix ine zvinhu zvose 0. Determinant yematrix ye 2×2 M=[a b ; c d] inonyorwa |M|=ad-bc. Doyun akati, 'Determinant yehuwandu hwematrix maviri yakaenzana nehuwandu hwema determinant awo. Ndiko kuti, |A+B|=|A|+|B|.' Sehumbowo, akayedza A=[1 0 ; 0 0] ne B=[0 1 ; 1 0], uye |A+B|=|[1 1 ; 1 0]|=-1 ne |A|+|B|=0+(-1)=-1, zvakaenzana.
y-m-43-06.thinking.1: Gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa zvakananga uye utarise mamiriro awunoputsika pasi pawo
y-m-43-06.thinking.2: Nyora kupokana pamwe chete nehwaro hwako

y-m-43-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja A kana B kuva dzimwe matrix uye uenzanise |A+B| ne |A|+|B| zvakananga.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.a: Sezvo peya imwe yakashanda, tinogona kufungidzira kuti dzimwe peya dzinoshandawo
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakawedzera kubudirira kumwe kunyaya dzose. Muedzo wokutsvaga mapeya umo isingashande unoshayikwa.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.b: Pane muenzaniso umo inoshanda, saka chirevo chinotongwa chakanganisa
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.b: Muenzaniso umo inoshanda hauiti kuti chirevo chikanganise. Chinoita kuti chikanganise muenzaniso umo isingashande (muenzaniso unopikisa).
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.c: Humbowo hwapera nepeya imwe chete, saka tinongoda kutarisa kuti hapana kukanganisa kuverenga, uye hapana muenzaniso unopikisa unodikanwa
y-m-43-06.s.s1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakatora muenzaniso mumwe sokuratidza 'nguva dzose'. Kunyange kuverenga kwakarurama, mhando yaimiriridzwa nepeya iyoyo ishoma.
y-m-43-06.s.s1.o.d: Peya imwe humbowo hwakapera simba, saka tinofanira kuyedza zvakawanda kuti tione kana paine mapeya anoiputsa
y-m-43-06.s.s1.explain: Muenzaniso mumwe umo inoshanda humbowo hwakapera simba hwokuti chirevo chichokwadi. Panguva ino zvinhu zvakawanda zve A zvaiva 0, saka kukosha kuviri kwakangoenzana. Kuyedza chirevo, unofanira kutsvaga mapeya anochiputsa.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.prompt: Kana A iri identity matrix E=[1 0 ; 0 1], gadzira B=[p q ; r s] 3 dzinoita kuti |E+B| ne |E|+|B| zvisiyane. Ita zvinhu zvive nhamba dzizere, uye B dzinova nokukosha kwakafanana kwa (p+s) ne |B| dzinoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ngatiti zvinhu zve B ndi p, q, r, s uye unyore E+B nedeterminant yayo.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.hint.1: Isa zvirevo zviviri zvakaparadzirwa zve |E+B| ne |E|+|B| padivi pedzimwe uye utsvage chikamu chipi chakasiyana.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Zvinhu inhamba dzizere kubva pa -5 kusvika pa 5.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita zvinhu zvive nhamba dzizere kubva pa -5 kusvika pa 5.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.fail.c2: |E+B| ne |E|+|B| zvakafanana. Nyora kukosha kuviri nomuna p, q, r, s uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-43-06.s.s2.explain: |E+B|=(1+p)(1+s)-qr=1+(p+s)+(ps-qr) uye |E|+|B|=1+(ps-qr). Musiyano wazvo ndi p+s, ndiko kuti, huwandu hwezvinhu zviviri zvendiagonali ze B. Saka kana p+s≠0, fomula yaDoyun inoputsika, uye kana p+s=0, inongoshanda kuna A iyi (=E). Peya yakayedzwa naDoyun pakutanga yaiva kungoitika kwakadaro zvakare.
y-m-43-06.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yokutumira kuna Doyun. Uchishandisa muenzaniso umwe wawakagadzira pamusoro, ratidza kuti fomula yaDoyun haigari ichishanda, uye unyore chikonzero chimwe chokuti peya imwe chete yakayedzwa naDoyun yakanga isingagoni kuratidza izvi.
y-m-43-06.s.s3.hint.0: Na B imwe yawakagadzira pamusoro, nyora E+B uye unyore determinant yayo senhamba.
y-m-43-06.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa zvinhu zvema A ne B zvakayedzwa naDoyun na B yawakangogadzira uye utaure kuti musiyano uri upi.

y-m-43-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here kuti sei 'yakashanda kamwe' isiri 'inogara ichishanda' nomuedzo waDoyun (zvinhu zvakawanda zve A zvi 0)?

y-m-43-06.s.s3.model.0: Haigari ichishanda. Kana A=E ne B=[1 0 ; 0 0], saka |E+B|=|[2 0 ; 0 1]|=2 asi |E|+|B|=1+0=1. Peya imwe chete yawakayedza yaiva nyaya yakangoshanda.

y-m-43-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yomuenzaniso inopa muenzaniso unopikisa nechikonzero nedzimwe nhamba.

y-m-43-10.goal: Tonga kana key matrix ichigona kushandiswa, gadzira zvakananga kiyi inogona kuparadzwa nekuverenga kwemaintegers oga, uye utsanangure mamiriro iwayo neformula yeinverse matrix.
y-m-43-10.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsara nemutsara, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) mutsara wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] imatrix ine mutsara wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsara wechipiri 0, 1. E iidentity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O izero matrix ine maentries ose i0. Maintegers maviri (x, y) anotorwa secolumn vector [x ; y], uye key matrix K=[a b ; c d] yakawanzwa kubva kuruboshwe, [ax+by ; cx+dy], inotumirwa senoti. Divi rinogamuchira chishandiso chinogona kuverenga maintegers oga, saka rinowanza inverse matrix yeK pamusoro penoti kuti rizvidzore (x, y) yekutanga, asi haigoni kushandiswa kana maentries einverse matrix aine mafraction. Formula yeinverse matrix: kana ad-bc≠0, saka K^(-1) = (1/(ad-bc)) · [d -b ; -c a].

y-m-43-10.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekuona kamwe formula yeinverse matrix yematrix e2×2 (formula yakanyorwa mumutsara)
y-m-43-10.s.s1.prompt: Cheolsu anoti achashandisa K=[2 1 ; 4 2] sekiyi. Sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru nezvekiyi iyi.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.hint.0: Wanza K pamapeya maviri akasiyana emaintegers (1, 1) ne(0, 3) uye uenzanise migumisiro.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.hint.1: Wana kukosha kwe ad-bc yeK uye uongorore kana ichigona kuiswa muformula yeinverse matrix.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.o.a: Haigoni kushandiswa. Pane nyaya umo mapeya emaintegers akasiyana anova noti imwe chete
y-m-43-10.s.s1.o.b: Inogona kushandiswa. Maentries ose maintegers, saka mapeya emaintegers anodzoka semaintegers
y-m-43-10.s.s1.r.b: Kuva nemaentries emaintegers nekugona kuparadzwa zvinhu zvakasiyana. Sarudza mapeya maviri akasiyana, uwanze K pamusoro pawo, uye uenzanise migumisiro.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.o.c: Inogona kushandiswa. Hapana entry i0, saka kusanganisa kunokwana
y-m-43-10.s.s1.r.c: Kuti inosanganisa zvakadini hakusarudze kana inogona kuparadzwa. Ongorora hukama pakati pemutsara wekutanga nemutsara wechipiri.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kuziva. Tinogona kuziva nekuiisa muformula yeinverse matrix, uye hatigoni kuongorora kana mafraction achibuda
y-m-43-10.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kuziva pakarepo nekuverenga denominator ad-bc yeformula. Mafraction asati abuda, tanga waongorora kana ichigona kuiswa muformula zvachose.
y-m-43-10.s.s1.explain: Kune K=[2 1 ; 4 2], ad-bc=2×2-1×4=0, saka hapana inverse matrix. Chaizvo, kuwanza (1, 1) ne(0, 3) neK kunopa (3, 6) kune zvose, saka divi rinogamuchira haringasarudze kuti raiva ripi.
y-m-43-10.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makiyi matatu akasiyana K=[a b ; c d] anogona kuparadzwa nedivi rinogamuchira nemaintegers oga. Mamiriro: a, b, c, d maintegers kubva pa-9 kusvika pa9 uye ose asiri zero, uye K ine inverse matrix ine maentries ose maintegers.
y-m-43-10.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti denominator ad-bc inofanira kuva nekukosha kupi kuti mafraction arege kumuka muformula yeinverse matrix.

Maentries ose maintegers, saka unogona kuparadza uchishandisa maintegers oga. Kuti maentries ose einverse matrix ave maintegers, ad-bc inofanira kugovanisa a, b, c, d dzose, uye ipapo (ad-bc)² inogovanisa ad-bc, saka ad-bc inofanira kuva 1 kana -1.

y-m-43-08.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nomutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) ndiwo mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] imatrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nomutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E ndiyo identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O ndiyo zero matrix ine zvinhu zvose 0. Fungidzira kuti vatengi vanoshandisa makefi maviri 가 ne 나 mudhorobha vane huwandu hwe 1000 zuva rega rega, uye hakuna munhu mutsva anouya kana anoenda. Zuva rega rega, 80% yevatengi va 가 vanoenda ku 가 zvakare mangwana uye 20% vanoenda ku 나, uye 90% yevatengi va 나 vanoenda ku 나 zvakare mangwana uye 10% vanoenda ku 가. Mareti aya akafanana zuva rega rega, uye kunyange kana huwandu hwevanhu hwuchibuda sedhesimali, uchengete sezvazvakaita mukuverenga. Nyora mamiriro se X=[huwandu hwevatengi ku 가 ; huwandu hwevatengi ku 나], uye mamiriro ezuva rinotevera ndi M=[0.8 0.1 ; 0.2 0.9] yakawanzwa na X. y-m-43-09.topic: Mhinduro dzesystem yemaequation elinear nematrix yemacoefficient
y-m-43-09.goal: Usingapedzisi kuti pane mhinduro imwe nokuti nhamba yezvisingazivikanwi nemaequation yakafanana, siyanisa nyaya umo pasina mhinduro kana dzakawanda zvichienderana nemacoefficients nekukosha kuri kudivi rekurudyi, uye ugadzire maequation ane mhinduro yakagadzikwa kuita imwe uye anoita mamiriro.
y-m-43-09.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsara nemutsara, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) mutsara wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] imatrix ine mutsara wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsara wechipiri 0, 1. E iidentity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O izero matrix ine maentries ose i0. System yemaequation elinear x+2y=4, 2x+ny=k inonyorwa nemamatrix se [1 2 ; 2 n]·[x ; y]=[4 ; k]. Equation yekutanga inoramba sezvayakaita, uye coefficient n ye y mu equation yechipiri nekukosha k kuri kudivi rekurudyi zvinoratidzwa nhanho nenhanho. x ne y nhamba chaiyo. y-m-43-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuisa (2, 1) muequation yechipiri kunopa 5, isingaenderani ne9. Fungazve kana pane mhinduro imwe kana mativi ekuruboshwe ari proportional.

y-m-43-09.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza n imwe, taura x nemitaurire ye y kubva muequation yekutanga, uiise muequation yechipiri, uye unyore y semutaurire we k.

y-m-43-09.s.s2.var.k: Kukosha k kuri kurudyi kweequation yechipiri

y-m-43-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Mumhinduro, y iri pasi pe2. Saka x=4-2y inewo yakanaka.

y-m-43-09.s.s2.explain: Kana n isiri 4, mhinduro imwe inogadzikwa ne y=(k-8)/(n-4), x=4-2y. Semuenzaniso, ne n=5 ne k=9, y=1 ne x=2, uye ne n=6 ne k=9, y=1/2 ne x=3. y inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 0 uye iri pasi pe2 kuti x ivewo yakanaka.

y-m-43-01.title: Kutarisa mhinduro yekuwedzera yaHyeonu
y-m-43-01.topic: Kuwedzera matrix ne commutative law: kuwedzera (A+B)^2
y-m-43-01.goal: Tarisa mutsara nemutsara kana mutemo wekuwedzera waunoshandisa zvakajairika mukuverenga nenhamba uchishandiswawo kuma matrices sezvawakaita, gadzira ma matrices apo mutemo unoputsika, uye utonge zvimiro zve matrices apo mutemo unopona.
y-m-43-01.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsara nemutsara, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) ndiwo mutsara wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] ndiyo matrix ine mutsara wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsara wechipiri 0, 1. E ndiyo identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O ndiyo zero matrix ine ma entries ose 0. Pane ma matrices maviri A=[1 1 ; 0 1] ne B=[1 0 ; 1 1]. Hyeonu akawedzera (A+B)^2 sezvazvakaita pazasi. Fungidzira kuti zvibvumirano zvekuwedzera nekuwedzera ma matrices chete ndizvo zvinogona kushandiswa pamutsara mumwe nemumwe, uye utsvage mutsara wakanyorwa pasina hwaro. (Mu expressions, A^2 ndiyo matrix A yakawedzerwa kaviri.)
y-m-43-01.thinking.0: Tsvaga mutsara wakasvetuka pasina hwaro mumhinduro
y-m-43-01.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso apo mutemo usingashande (mienzaniso inopikisa)
y-m-43-01.prereq.0: H3 yebasa iri inongova chiratidzo chenhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro yekugoverwa uku kwekugadzira, kwete chiratidzo chekuti curriculum inaipa kugiredhi iyoyo. Inofungidzira kuti watodzidza tsananguro ye matrix nesum, product, ne identity matrix ye ma matrices e 2×2.
y-m-43-01.prereq.1: Kuverenga product ye ma matrices e 2×2 (kuita mapeya e ma entries emutsara wekutanga nema column ekutanga uye kuwedzera, nezvimwewo)
y-m-43-01.prereq.2: Kuwedzera kwenhamba (a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2 (nhanho ye middle school grade 3)
y-m-43-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mumhinduro yaHyeonu usingagoni kubuda kubva pazvibvumirano oga. Mimwe mitsara inoratidzikawo yakarurama pakuverenga.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa mutsara mumwe nemumwe nemutsara uri pamberi pawo uye utsvage zvakachinja.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ne A ne B zvebasa iri, verenga AB ne BA zvakananga uye uenzanise kana mhedzisiro mbiri dzakafanana.
y-m-43-01.s.s1.line.1: = A·A + A·B + B·A + B·B   (govera, asi chengeta kurongeka kwekuwedzera sezvakaita)
y-m-43-01.s.s1.line.2: = A^2 + AB + AB + B^2   (fungidzira kuti kunyora AB panzvimbo ye BA kwakafanana)
y-m-43-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Mutsara 2 une AB ne BA zvakaparadzana, asi mutsara 3 wakanyora zvakare BA se AB. Kune nhamba ab=ba, saka kutsiva kunobvumirwa, asi kuma matrices hapana chibvumirano chekuti AB ne BA dzakaenzana. Mutsara 4 mhedzisiro yakatora kunyora zvakare uku, saka iexpression isingashande nenzira yakajairika. Asi izvi hazvireve kuti mhinduro iyi yakashata kune A, B dzipi neipi. Munyaya apo AB ne BA dzakaenzana, inoshanda sezvayakaita. Tarisa mumadanho anotevera.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.prompt: Chengeta A=[1 1 ; 0 1] sezvayakaita, uye ugadzire B=[p q ; r s] 2 dzakasiyana apo AB ne BA dzakasiyana. Ma entries p, q, r, s ndema integer kubva ku-3 kusvika ku3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.hint.0: Rega ma entries e B ave p, q, r, s uye unyore ma entries mana e AB ne BA rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa ma entries e AB ne BA padivi pemumwe imwe neimwe uye utsvage ma entries anogona kusiyana.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.p: Entry p mumutsara wekutanga, column yekutanga ye B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.q: Entry q mumutsara wekutanga, column yechipiri ye B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.r: Entry r mumutsara wechipiri, column yekutanga ye B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.var.s: Entry s mumutsara wechipiri, column yechipiri ye B
y-m-43-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma entries i ma integers kubva ku -3 kusvika ku 3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita ma entries ma integers kubva ku -3 kusvika ku 3.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.ok.c2: AB ne BA zvakasiyana. Expression yekupedzisira yaHyeonu inoputsika neB iyi.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.fail.c2: AB ne BA zvakafanana. Verenga ma entries mana ema products maviri rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise.
y-m-43-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana B=[1 0 ; 1 1], saka AB=[2 1 ; 1 1] uye BA=[1 1 ; 1 2], dzakasiyana. Sezvo (A+B)^2 - (A^2+2AB+B^2) = BA - AB, kune B apo AB ne BA zvakasiyana, expression yekupedzisira yaHyeonu i yakaipa. Kune A iyi, kana entry iri mumutsetse wechipiri, column yekutanga ye B isiri 0, kana ma diagonal entries maviri e B akasiyana, AB ne BA zvinova zvakasiyana.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza ma B ese apo (A+B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2 inoshanda chaizvo kana A=[1 1 ; 0 1]. Usasarudza nemaziso; zvakanaka kutarisa mamwe nekuverenga zvakananga.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.hint.0: Isa chimiro chakawedzerwa che (A+B)^2 padivi pe A^2+2AB+B^2, uye uronge kuti musiyano wayo unonyorwa sei ne AB ne BA.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.hint.1: Usati waverenga AB ne BA pa candidate imwe neimwe, tanga watarisa ma entries akaparadzanisa AB ne BA mudanho rakapfuura (entry iri mumutsetse wechipiri, column yekutanga, nemusiyano wema diagonal entries maviri).
y-m-43-01.s.s3.r.a: Iyi i B chaiyo apo AB ne BA zvaiva zvakasiyana mudanho rakapfuura. Ungangodaro usati wabatanidza kuti mamiriro ekuti expression ishande i 'AB ne BA zvakaenzana'.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.r.c: Ine chimiro che upper triangular sa A, saka inogona kuoneka yakafanana, asi kana ukatonga nemufungo wekuti zvimiro zvakafanana chete, unosiya musiyano pakati pe AB ne BA. Verenga zvakananga.
y-m-43-01.s.s3.explain: (A+B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2 inoshanda chaizvo kana AB=BA. Kuti A iyi ive ne AB=BA, entry iri mumutsetse wechipiri, column yekutanga ye B inofanira kuva 0 uye ma diagonal entries maviri anofanira kuenzana. [2 0 ; 0 2], [3 5 ; 0 3], [0 1 ; 0 0] i zviitiko zvakadaro, uye [1 0 ; 1 1] ne [1 2 ; 0 2] hazvisizvo. Kunyange kana ma entries mazhinji i 0, unofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana kana AB=BA.

y-m-43-03.title: Kudzosera poinzi yakafambiswa kaviri kuna pakatanga
y-m-43-03.topic: Kurongeka kwema transformations anotevedzana nema inverse matrices
y-m-43-03.goal: Tonga kuti chii chaunofanira kuziva kuti udzose mhedzisiro yekuita ma transformations maviri nenhevedzano, sarudza matrix inoidzosera, uye uwane zvakananga mapoinzi apo mhedzisiro i imwechete kana kurongeka kwachinjwa.
y-m-43-03.material: Matrix inonyorwa mutsetse nemutsetse, uye zviri pamberi pe semicolon (;) i mutsetse wekutanga. Semuenzaniso, [1 1 ; 0 1] i matrix ine mutsetse wekutanga 1, 1 nemutsetse wechipiri 0, 1. E i identity matrix [1 0 ; 0 1], uye O i zero matrix ine ma entries ese 0. Poinzi (x, y) inonyorwa se column vector [x ; y], uye matrix inowanzwa kubva kuruboshwe kufambisa poinzi. Matrix A=[1 1 ; 0 1] inofambisa poinzi (x, y) kuenda ku (x+y, y), uye B=[2 0 ; 0 1] inofambisa poinzi (x, y) kuenda ku (2x, y). A ne B zvose zvine inverse matrices. A ne B zvakaitwa kamwe kamwe, nenhevedzano imwe, imwe mushure meimwe, kupoinzi imwe. Tinoziva poinzi yakabuda chete uye tinoda kudzorera poinzi yekutanga. Inverse matrix ye A inonyorwa A^(-1), uye inverse matrix ye B inonyorwa B^(-1).
y-m-43-03.thinking.0: Tonga kuti ruzivo rupi rwakawanda runodiwa
y-m-43-03.thinking.1: Uwane kuti kurongeka kwema transformations anotevedzana kunokanganisa sei mhedzisiro
y-m-43-03.prereq.1: Ma products e 2×2 matrices nekuverenga kuwanza column vector ne matrix
y-m-43-03.prereq.2: Kugona kubvuma zvinoreva inverse matrix (matrix inopa E kana yawanzwa) uye chokwadi chekuti kana ma matrices maviri ese aine inverse matrices, product yawo ineyo inverse matrix zvakare
y-m-43-03.s.s1.prompt: Chaerin akati, 'Takaita transformation kaviri uye A ne B imwe neimwe ine inverse matrix, saka tinogona kudzorera poinzi yekutanga.' Kuti usarudze maitiro ekuidzosera, chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva kunze kweizvi?
y-m-43-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pa poinzi (1, 2), tevera poinzi yakabuda muchiitiko apo A yakaitwa kutanga ipapo B, uye muchiitiko apo B yakaitwa kutanga ipapo A.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana mapoinzi akabuda ezviitiko zviviri akafanana, uye kana asina, funga kana nzira yekudzosera ingaita imwechete.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.a: Kana uchiziva poinzi yekutanga, haufaniri kuidzorera. Maitiro ekudzosera haasarudzwe nemitengo yepoinzi asi nekurongeka kwema transformations nema matrices.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.b: Ndeipi pa A ne B yakaitwa kutanga
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.c: Kuti A^(-1) ne B^(-1) i matrix imwechete here
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.c: A ne B zvakasiyana, saka ma inverse matrices maviri akasiyanawo. Kuti i imwechete here hazvisi ruzivo runosarudza maitiro ekudzosera.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.o.d: Kuti poinzi yakabuda haisi origin here
y-m-43-03.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange kana mhedzisiro i origin kana kwete, unodzosera nematrix imwechete. Ungangodaro wakafunga kuti nzira inoenderana nemitengo yepoinzi.
y-m-43-03.s.s1.explain: Maitiro ekudzosera anoenderana ne 'chii chakaitwa kutanga'. Kana ukaisa A kutanga uye ipapo B kupoinzi (1, 2), inova (6, 2), uye kana ukaisa B kutanga uye ipapo A, inova (4, 2). Mhedzisiro dzakasiyana, saka nzira yekudzosera haigone kuva imwechete. Mitengo yepoinzi haidiwi kusarudza matrix inodzosera.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.prompt: Ikozvino unoziva kuti 'A yakaitwa kutanga ipapo B'. Matrix ipi inopa poinzi yekutanga kana yawanzwa kupoinzi yakabuda?
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.0: Poinzi yekutanga (1, 2) yakava (6, 2) ne A ipapo B. Isa candidate imwe neimwe ku (6, 2) iyi uye utarise kana (1, 2) ichidzoka.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana product ye matrices yaiswa kupoinzi, sarudza kana matrix yekurudyi kana yekuruboshwe inoiswa kutanga, uye uienzanise nekuti matrix ipi yaiva transformation yekupedzisira.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukawanza matrix product B^(-1)A^(-1) kupoinzi, yekurudyi, A^(-1), inoiswa kutanga. Enzanisa izvi nenhevedzano yaunodzosera nayo uchitanga ne transformation yekupedzisira.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.b: Matrix inowedzera kudzosera kuviri haidzosere poinzi kaviri asi inowedzera mhedzisiro mbiri. Kuisa nenhevedzano nekuwedzera zvakasiyana.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.r.c: Inverse matrix ye A+B haisi inverse yekuisa A ne B nenhevedzano. Huwandu i operation yakasiyana nekuita rimwe mushure merimwe.
y-m-43-03.s.s2.explain: Kana poinzi yafambiswa ne A ipapo B, poinzi yakabuda i B(A x) (poinzi yekutanga x yakawanzwa kutanga ne A uye ipapo mhedzisiro iyoyo ne B). Kuidzorera, unofanira kutanga wadzosera yekupedzisira yakaitwa, B (B^(-1)), uye ipapo wadzosera A (A^(-1)). Kana uchiwanza ma matrices, matrix yekurudyi inoiswa kutanga, saka i A^(-1)B^(-1). Muenzaniso: kana poinzi yekutanga (1, 2) yakava (6, 2), B^(-1) inopa (3, 2) uye A^(-1) inodzosera (1, 2).
y-m-43-03.s.s3.prompt: Pane poinzi apo mhedzisiro i imwechete pasinei nekurongeka here? Wana uye uise mapoinzi maviri akasiyana e integer (x, y), asiri origin, apo 'mhedzisiro yekuita A kutanga ipapo B' ne 'mhedzisiro yekuita B kutanga ipapo A' i imwechete.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nema x ne y ma coordinates epoinzi inowanikwa nekuisa A kutanga ipapo B kupoinzi (x, y). Nyora chiitiko apo B yakaitwa kutanga nenzira imwechete.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kana ukaenzanisa ma coordinates ekutanga emapoinzi maviri, tarisa kuti hukama hupi pakati pe x ne y hunosara.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c1: I poinzi ine ma coordinates e integer uye x isiri 0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Ita poinzi ine ma coordinates e integer uye x isiri 0.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Mhedzisiro dzekurongeka kuviri i dzakafanana. (Coordinate yekutanga yakafanana, uye coordinate yechipiri inogara iri y.)
y-m-43-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Mhedzisiro dzekurongeka kuviri dzakasiyana. Nyora mhedzisiro ye A kutanga ipapo B nemhedzisiro ye B kutanga ipapo A rimwe nerimwe se (x, y) uye uienzanise.
y-m-43-03.s.s3.explain: Kana ukaita A kutanga ipapo B, (x, y) inopfuura (x+y, y) uye inova (2x+2y, y). Kana ukaita B kutanga ipapo A, inopfuura (2x, y) uye inova (2x+y, y). Kuti ma coordinates ekutanga aenzane, 2y=y, ndiko kuti, y=0. Saka kurongeka hakukosha pamapoinzi ari pa x-axis chete, uye pamapoinzi mamwe kurongeka kunochinja mhedzisiro.
